change.title: pr-80528-flat
change.description: ref(crons): Reorganize incident creation / issue occurrence logic
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context builds `config` with the display schedule_type but returns the raw `monitor.config`
findings.body: Lines 160-162 copy the config and replace `schedule_type` with `get_schedule_type_display()`. Line 168 then returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config`, so the copy is never used. The event context therefore carries the raw schedule_type value, not the display string. The serializer (`src/sentry/monitors/serializers.py:240-242`) uses the display value in the same situation. This code was moved unchanged, so the bug already existed in `mark_failed.py`. Changing the returned value would change the occurrence payload, so I'd leave it out of this move-only PR. Either fix it in a follow-up or drop the dead `config` lines.

contracts.action: mark_failed now delegates to try_incident_threshold, which calls create_incident_occurrence. These are the old mark_failed_threshold and create_issue_platform_occurrence, moved into new modules and renamed.
contracts.equivalent_path: The removed mark_failed_threshold and create_issue_platform_occurrence in mark_failed.py (base commit). Their bodies are line-for-line identical to the new try_incident_threshold (incidents.py:14-104) and create_incident_occurrence (incident_occurrence.py:28-113).
contracts.before_after: Before: mark_failed updated MonitorEnvironment, refreshed it, then called mark_failed_threshold(failed_checkin, failure_issue_threshold, received). After: it makes the same call through try_incident_threshold with the same arguments (mark_failed.py:79). The threshold logic, the incident get_or_create, the mute check, the occurrence loop and the monitor_environment_failed signal are unchanged. SimpleCheckIn moved to types.py:105 with the same fields. The lazy imports of sentry.signals, sentry.issues.issue_occurrence and sentry.issues.producer are kept inside the functions. The only top-level import that could add an import cycle is the new `mark_failed -> incidents -> incident_occurrence` chain. incident_occurrence imports the same sentry.issues.grouptype, monitors.models and monitors.types that mark_failed imported before.
contracts.visible_effect: None. Incidents and issue-platform occurrences are produced as before. The only remaining callers of mark_failed are monitor_consumer, check_timeout and check_missed, and they import only `mark_failed`, which is still defined. A repo-wide search found no other reference to the removed names. The `mark_failed.py:NNN` references in the locale .po files are generated comments.
contracts.failure_mode: No new async call, wait or retry. Failure handling is as before: exceptions from produce_occurrence_to_kafka propagate to the mark_failed caller. Nothing in the PR changes that.

summary: This PR is a behaviour-preserving move. The threshold and incident logic go to `incidents.py`, the occurrence building goes to `incident_occurrence.py`, and `SimpleCheckIn` goes to `types.py`. Bodies are identical to the removed code, and no other file referenced the removed names. The one finding is a dead `config` copy in `get_monitor_environment_context` that already existed before the move.
